newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Generale Bank offers rest of rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank offers rest of rights issue.

text.p: Belgium's Generale Bank NV said on Thursday it was offering investors a scrip issue covering 84,407 shares not subscribed to by existing shareholders.
The shares are left over from a rights issue of 1,498,777 shares which closed on October 4. Of that issue 94.4 percent was taken up, the bank said in a statement.
The remaining shares, with VVPR (reduced tax) strips, can be subscribed to at a price of 10,250 Belgian francs each. To get one new share the investor must hold 10 subscription rights.
The rights, represented by coupon number six, go on sale at the Brussels and Antwerp bourses on October 15.
Subscriptions must be submitted by October 22 at the latest.
The issue price compares with a market price of 10,700.
